name: phone
description: Your agent uses apps on a spare Android phone you set aside for it: WhatsApp Business, Instagram, a bank app, anything that lives only on a phone. It reads the screen, taps and types over your Tailscale network. Nothing is installed on the phone. Sending, posting, deleting and paying follow the same rules you set for the browser: paying asks you first, and careful makes all four ask.

verbs.name: phone
verbs.summary: use apps on a spare Android phone (read the screen, tap, type)

setup.hint: phone talks to the phone with adb, Android's own debugging tool, which 5dive will not install behind your back. The command below installs it (apt boxes: Debian, Ubuntu). The phone and this server must be on the same Tailscale network. Then ask your agent to "connect my phone".
